title: Fix out-of-bounds draw pass errors when exporting with the shader baker
body:
## What problem(s) does this PR solve?

Exporting a project with the shader baker enabled (`shader_baker/enabled=true`, exported with a window, since the baker does not run headless) prints these errors for every `GPUParticles3D` that has fewer than four draw passes:

```
ERROR: Index p_pass = 1 is out of bounds (draw_passes.size() = 1).
   at: get_draw_pass_mesh (scene/3d/gpu_particles_3d.cpp:309)
ERROR: Index p_pass = 2 is out of bounds (draw_passes.size() = 1).
ERROR: Index p_pass = 3 is out of bounds (draw_passes.size() = 1).
```

Reproducible in 4.5.stable, 4.7.1.stable, 4.7.2.stable and master (2bbcb4960e). 

### Steps to reproduce
1. New project with the Mobile or Forward+ renderer.
2. Add a `GPUParticles3D` with a `ParticleProcessMaterial` and a `QuadMesh` in `draw_pass_1` (leave `draw_passes` at 1), save the scene.
3. Add a Windows export preset and enable "Shader Baker".
4. Export from the editor (not `--headless`).

MRP:  [godot-mrp-baker-particles.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/33264874/godot-mrp-baker-particles.zip)
It already has both presets: "Windows Desktop" (baker on) shows the errors, "Windows Desktop no baker" exports cleanly.

## Additional information
`EditorExportPlatform::_export_customize_object` walks `get_property_list()` and calls `get()` on every `OBJECT` property without checking its usage. `GPUParticles3D` hides `draw_pass_2` to `draw_pass_4` when `draw_passes` is lower, but they stay in the list, so the walk reads them and `get_draw_pass_mesh` fails its bounds check. This only shows with the baker because it is the export plugin that makes the export customize objects.

The fix skips properties without `PROPERTY_USAGE_STORAGE`. Those are never written to the exported resource, so customizing them could not change the export; the only difference is that they are no longer read.

The same errors were mentioned in a review comment on the shader baker PR: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/102552#discussion_r2100528501

Tested on Windows with editor builds of master with and without the change:
- MRP with the baker: 3 errors before, none after. Without the baker: none either way.
- A full game (6,162 files), Windows and Linux presets: 54 errors before, none after.
- The exported packs contain the same files; the only byte differences are in `.scn` files that also differ between two exports of unmodified master.
- `--test` gives the same result on both builds.

AI disclosure: I Claude code (opus) to trace the cause and suggest the fix, and to run the builds and tests above. I reviewed the change and the results.
